events.title: Scenario: AI compute growth pressures substation capacity in data-center corridors
events.summary: AI and compute growth may be concentrating substation upgrade demand in specific corridors, which could stress transformer procurement and commissioning capacity. Monitoring procurement windows and utility upgrade notices is critical.

events.title: Scenario: Transformer manufacturing lead-time pressure from minerals and shipping
events.summary: Transformer supply-chain signals may point to extended lead times driven by mineral and shipping constraints, increasing schedule risk for transmission and substation projects.

events.title: Scenario: HVDC adoption as a pathway for offshore renewables encounters integration frictions
events.summary: HVDC is a promising connector for offshore renewables but may create system-integration frictions that require expanded testing, updated protection schemes, and stronger operator coordination.

events.title: Scenario: Battery storage ramp interacting with electrolyzer loads creates new balancing needs
events.summary: Co-located growth in storage and electrolyzers may materially alter flexibility needs; coordination and updated market signals will influence whether the net effect is stabilizing or destabilizing.

events.title: Scenario: Critical-mineral sourcing signals tighten equipment availability
events.summary: Upstream mineral sourcing constraints could materially influence delivery windows for transformers and batteries, increasing project allocation risk and procurement complexity.

events.title: Scenario: Grid digitization accelerates but raises cybersecurity exposure for control systems
events.summary: Faster grid digitization increases operational capability but could heighten cybersecurity risks on control systems if security and standards do not keep pace.

events.title: Scenario: Modular substation adoption accelerates regional grid expansion but tests standards throughput
events.summary: Modular substations offer a pathway to accelerate expansion where traditional procurement is slow, but their success depends on scaling standards, testing, and local integration capacity.

events.title: Scenario: Renewables and storage change ancillary-service demand profiles
events.summary: Ancillary-service needs are shifting with renewables and storage; timely market-product redesign could accelerate investment in required flexibility, while delays could increase reliability and curtailment risks.

events.title: Scenario: OEM concentration and aftermarket risk could reduce spare-part options
events.summary: Concentration in equipment supply and aftermarket services may reduce spare-part options, elevating operational downtime risk and increasing inventory costs for operators.

events.title: Scenario: Transmission permitting friction increases project delay risk
events.summary: Permitting frictions are a plausible source of transmission schedule risk; extended delays could increase local congestion and operational costs.
